messages.text:
Hi,

I saw on your website that you have installed 10,000 plus solar systems and still handle big O and M work too. That is a seriously strong track record.

Wanted to reach out and see if you are experiencing the same problem as majority of solar companies we ecountered. Its usually not being able to answer to customer inquries in time or losing a lot time manually qualifying leads. Either via mobile, email or whatsapp.

We solve this by building Voice and Chat Agents for solar companies. It chats with customers, qualifies each one and saves them to your CRM (like ServiceTitan). Its connected to your calendar and email. Our clients usually recover around 25hrs every week using this approach.

Give me a quick yes and I'll send you a 4-min video showing how the agent handles solar inquries.

Best,
Mia Malcic

messages.subject: vraag over service buiten kantoor
messages.text:
Hoi,

Ik zag op jullie site dat jullie ook service en onderhoud doen. Dat lijkt me best druk, zeker als er ook vragen buiten kantooruren binnenkomen.

Net een build afgerond voor een zonnepanelen-installateur in Berlijn. Hun team was bijna 3 uur per dag kwijt aan het beantwoorden van dezelfde vragen via WhatsApp en e-mail. Reactietijd teruggebracht tot onder de 4 minuten, 24 uur per dag. Ze boekten in de eerste 6 weken 11 extra geboekte locatiebezoeken.

Ik doe dit specifiek voor zonnepanelenbedrijven. Ik bouw een AI die elke vraag 24/7 afhandelt via telefoon, WhatsApp, e-mail en websitechat. Hij kwalificeert elke lead en boekt ze direct in uw agenda zonder dat iemand in uw team eraan hoeft te zitten. Ik bouw het geheel voor uw bedrijf zonder vooraf kosten en heb het binnen 14 dagen live. Als u het na 30 dagen de moeite waard vindt om te houden, kunnen we samenwerken.

Ik heb een clip van 2 minuten waarin een echte zonnepanelenvraag van begin tot eind wordt afgehandeld. Reageer en ik stuur hem door.

Met vriendelijke groet,
Mia Malcic
Co-founder @ Mindaptive

Beste klant,

Bedankt voor uw vraag, wij streven ernaar om elke vraag binnen vijf werkdagen te beantwoorden. In de tussen tijd kunt u kijken of het antwoord op uw vraag in onze FAQ staat, die u op de volgende link vindt: https://solarengineers.nl/category/faq/

Wij waarderen u geduld.

Met vriendelijke groet,

Het team van Solar Engineers

Hoi, grappige timing. Ik kreeg jullie automatische antwoord over vertraagde reacties net na het versturen van een e-mail over hoe trage reactietijden zonnebedrijven opdrachten laten missen. Geen kritiek op jullie, het bevestigt gewoon precies waar het om ging.

Als dit beter past bij iemand van sales of ops, zou het top zijn als je het kunt doorsturen. Bedankt!

Met vriendelijke groet,
Mia

Hoi,

Ik zag op jullie website dat jullie werken met uurprijzen en mikken op 1 miljoen slimme energiefans in 2030. Mooie ambitie, dat vraagt vast veel strakke opvolging.

Ik wilde even contact opnemen om te zien of u hetzelfde probleem ervaart als de meeste zonnepanelenbedrijven die we tegenkomen. Meestal is dat het niet op tijd kunnen beantwoorden van klantvragen of veel tijd verliezen aan het handmatig kwalificeren van leads. Via mobiel, e-mail of WhatsApp.

We lossen dit op door Voice- en Chat Agents te bouwen voor zonnepanelenbedrijven. Hij praat met klanten, kwalificeert elke klant en slaat ze op in uw CRM (zoals ServiceTitan). Hij is verbonden met uw agenda en e-mail. Onze klanten winnen meestal zo'n 25hrs per week terug met deze aanpak.

Geef me een snel ja en ik stuur u een video van 4 minuten waarin u ziet hoe de agent zonnepanelenvragen afhandelt.

Met vriendelijke groet,
Mia Malčić

Ik heb momenteel zonnepanelen en saldeer, kan dat ook bij NextEnergy?
Bij NextEnergy staan we aan de voorhoede van de energietransitie, met een sterke focus op duurzame energieopwekking zoals zonnepanelen. Wij erkennen het belang van zelf opgewekte energie en ondersteunen actief het gebruik van zonnepanelen door onze klanten.
Salderingsregels bij NextEnergy
Als je zonnepanelen hebt en gebruikmaakt van salderingsregels, ben je bij NextEnergy aan het juiste adres. Wij vergoeden de daadwerkelijke marktprijzen voor zowel jouw energieverbruik als jouw energieopwekking. Dit betekent dat we voor elk uur jouw verbruik tegenover jouw opwekking salderen.
Meer Verbruikt dan Opgewekt? Als je in een bepaald uur meer energie verbruikt dan je hebt opgewekt, dan betaal je voor het extra verbruik tegen de marktprijs van dat uur.
Meer Opgewekt dan Verbruikt? Als je meer energie opwekt dan je verbruikt, vergoeden we je voor de extra opgewekte energie tegen de marktprijs van dat uur.

Belastingvoordeel op Netto Verbruik
Een belangrijk voordeel bij NextEnergy is dat je alleen belasting betaalt over je netto verbruik op jaarbasis. Dit betekent dat de energie die je opwekt en teruglevert aan het net, wordt afgetrokken van je totale energieverbruik voordat de belasting wordt berekend. Dit kan leiden tot aanzienlijke besparingen, vooral voor huishoudens met een hoge energieopwekking door zonnepanelen.

Beantwoordt dit artikel de vraag?

messages.subject: hjälp med inkommande samtal
messages.text:
Hej,

Jag såg på er webbplats att ni projekterar och installerar solceller i Stockholm. Det känns som ett fint upplägg, särskilt när det säkert kommer in många frågor vid sidan av jobbet.

Precis avslutat ett bygge åt en solinstallatör i Berlin. Deras team höll på att bränna nästan 3 timmar om dagen på att bara svara på samma frågor via WhatsApp och mejl. Vi pressade ner deras svarstid till under 4 minuter, dygnet runt. De drog in 11 extra bokade platsbesök under de första 6 veckorna.

Jag gör det här specifikt för solföretag. Bygger en AI som hanterar varje förfrågan 24/7 via samtal, WhatsApp, mejl och webbchatt. Den kvalificerar varje lead och bokar in dem direkt i din kalender utan att någon i ditt team behöver lyfta ett finger. Jag bygger hela grejen för ditt företag utan någon förskottskostnad och har den live inom 14 dagar. Om du tycker att den är värd att behålla efter 30 dagar kan vi jobba ihop.

Har ett 2-minutersklipp där den hanterar en riktig solförfrågan från start till slut. Svara så skickar jag över den.

Allt gott,
Andrew Juran
Co-Founder @ Mindaptive.ai

Vi har nu registrerat ditt ärende och du kommer inom kort bli kontaktad av oss på Kundsupport.
Vi kontaktar dig så snart vi bara kan, din fråga är viktig för oss.
Ha en fortsatt trevlig dag.
Med vänliga hälsningar
Solmax Energi AB

messages.subject: nice work on the store setup
messages.text:
Hi,

I saw on your website how Dunelm has grown from that first market stall into a big UK homewares name. That kind of steady growth is proper impressive.

Just finished a build for a solar installer in the Berlin. Their team was burning close to 3 hours a day just handling the same questions over WhatsApp and email. Dropped their response time to under 4 minutes, around the clock. They picked up 11 additional booked site visits in the first 6 weeks.

I do this specifically for solar companies. Build an AI that handles every inquiry 24/7 over calls, WhatsApp, email, website chat. It qualifies each lead, and books them straight into your calendar without anyone on your team touching it. I'll build the whole thing for your company at no charge upfront and have it live within 14 days. If you think it's worth keeping after 30 days, we can work together.

Have a 2-minute clip of it handling a real solar inquiry from start to finish. Reply and I'll send it over.

Best,

Thank you for contacting the Dunelm Community Team.

We are currently partnered with Age UK, working together to create communities that feel like home and tackle loneliness amongst older people.

We also consider requests to support other causes. If your enquiry is something we are able to assist with, a member of the team will be in touch.

For any Customer Support, please contact – customer.services@dunelm.com

For anything regarding Recruitment please contact – recruitmentsupport@dunelm.com

Thank you again for reaching out to Dunelm.

Kindest regards,

Dunelm Community Team

messages.subject: nice work keeping things compact
messages.text:
Hey Newair team,

I like how Newair has stayed rooted in Orange County for so long while building out so many compact home appliances. The mix of wine coolers, ice makers, and portable comfort gear stands out.. This might be out of the left field but I got a question for you.

When the summer rush comes along, how many calls from interested prospects go to voicemail?
Most Cypress HVAC owners tell me it lands in voicemail, and the caller just dials the next company instead of leaving a message. I help HVAC crews plug that gap so those calls turn into booked jobs instead of lost ones.

I am looking to set aside 15 to 20 minutes to get aligned on your current infrastructure priorities. How does Wednesday or Thursday morning work?

Cheers,
Andrew Juran
Co-founder @ Mindaptive.ai

Hi there,

Thanks for getting in touch with The Gym Group.

If your question has been resolved or you’ve already connected with our billing team on the phone, Live Chat team, or your local gym, that’s great!

If you still need help, here are our most common questions in our inbox right now, and a reminder to check out our [link: https://thegymsupport.freshdesk.com/support/home] Support site for information that may answer your questions.

Opening times- Please review your gym opening times  [link: https://www.thegymgroup.com/gym-opening-times/] here.

Payment queries- If you want to change your payment date, payment details or view your payment history, then head over to our app! For all other queries, we also have a dedicated billing team that can be reached by calling 0300 303 4800, Monday to Friday 9 am-5.30 pm.

Discounts- You can view all of our current offers and deals  [link: https://www.thegymgroup.com/gym-membership-deals-and-offers/] here. For Blue light discounts and Unidays discounts, you will need to enter your unique code during checkout. For any existing members trying to add this code, you would need to cancel and rejoin to benefit from your monthly discount offer. Please note that the off-peak membership is not included in these promotions & once a discount has expired we are unable to reactivate this.

Forgotten or haven’t received a PIN - Try the  [link: https://www.thegymgroup.com/forgotten-pin/] Retrieve my PIN form here. If you’ve recently paid and can’t retrieve your PIN you might have joined with a different email address or there was a typo when you signed up. If this seems like the case or you’re still not sure, reply back or reach us on  [link: https://thegymsupport.freshdesk.com/support/solutions/articles/44002527963-i-ve-forgotten-my-pin-how-do-i-get-a-reminder-] Live Chat and one of the team will get back to you.

Members must be aged 16 and over. If you are aged 16 or 17 you will need to complete the online induction before being allowed access to the gym. Children cannot be brought into our gyms.

Personal Trainers - are available in all our gyms to help you achieve your fitness goals! To view the dedicated team of PTs at your gym head  [link: https://www.thegymgroup.com/member-area/my-classes-and-pts/personal-trainers/] here.

Tours - You can view our open sites before you join by heading down between staffed hours and buzzing for a member of staff. Staffed hours for your branch will be displayed at the gym. They will show you around, but you will not be able to work out without buying a membership or a day pass.

Parking- Please head to your specific gym page to see if parking is available. Not all of our branches will have parking available. You may be eligible for free or reduced fee parking, but this is dependent on the branch so please refer to the travel by car notes and in gym signage.

Lost property - If you have lost property at the gym, we advise that you return to the gym at your earliest convenience to collect it – if it has been found, the manager will keep it safe for up to 14 days.

Your query is now closed however, if you have any other questions, please head over to our  [link: https://support.thegymgroup.com/support/home] support site or reply back here and a member of the team will get back to you.

Kind regards,

The Gym Group Customer Service Team

Subject: Reply from Smartech Gas Ltd

Thanks for your email enquiry, the following message covers most of the enquiries we receive.

To respond to you as quick as possible we have collated this reply to get back to you with the information you require in a timely manner. Anything not covered in this email please send a Whatsapp or text message to make us aware that you have emailed us just in case it has ended up in our spam or junk folders. A simple message with the words " I have sent you an email and my email address is info@smartechgas.co.uk " you don't have to duplicate the email as once we've been made aware we will look at email and reply at the next available time.

Please take the time to check all the information below as its most likely covered in this email.

Always the quickest way to book a job without having to speak to us is to book on our website. www.smartechgas.co.uk read below as your enquiry will most likely be covered in the information below. Then you can get booked in if your query is answered.

This email covers subjects that include:

If you need to cancel an existing appointment.

If you have double booked an appointment by accident.

Prices for common work types we do and details of what the job entails:

Services

Repairs

Disconnecting radiators or gas appliances

Smart Heating Controls

Cooker and Hob Installations

Landlord/Homeowner Safety Certificates

Boiler Quotes

Multiple Radiator Quotes

Boiler Installations

How to book an appointment and best ways to book.

Not received a confirmation email after booking

If you need to cancel an existing appointment.

If you need to cancel an existing appointment we understand that your circumstances can change, all we ask you is to let us know as soon as possible so we can cancel it at our end to free up the appointment for someone else to book not having the appointment avaliable limits the amount of jobs we can do on that day, if you email us can you follow up with a whatsapp up or text message as we don't get to see emails sometimes as the important emails get lost in other not so important emails and we then see them too late to be reactive to the cancellation. Thanks for your co-operation in this.

Double booked an appointment by accident.

Same as above advice.

Prices for common work types we do and details of what the job entails. All prices quoted includes VAT

Standard Boiler Service £90 this includes:

If you are wanting a service with a known fault on boiler this may be able to be sorted on the service but doesn't cover the repair as extra time maybe needed to do it, if it can be done in the time frame of the service then it would be covered.

1. Clean Condensate trap if required

2. Clean system filter if installed and where practical

3. Check expansion vessel and recharge with air if required

4. Inspect inside boiler for leaks on water gas and flue seals

5. Put boiler into service mode and check manufacturers guidance for correct combustion readings at minimum and maximum gas rates. Also fan pressure test on Worcester boilers when required

6. Check correct gas rate at gas meter or incoming burner pressure at boiler gas valve on maximum.

7. Check flue air integrity to ensure flue and flue seals are correct.

8. Check safety devices

9. Check Flue and Ventilation complies with current gas safety regulations

10. Fill out benchmark service book for boiler warranty if provided by customer and send email gas service record.

11. Check radiators if customer has problems with any and give advice on solutions. Any minor issues ie bleeding radiators included in service price.

12. Advise on any energy efficiency upgrades that would benefit customers if asked and advise on any safety related issues

If you require a Major Boiler Service these vary on Boiler Make and Model and can be given on request.

Major Boiler services consist of everything listed in the standard boiler service and fully stripping down boiler, jet washing the heat exchanger out and replacing the seals and other various service items recommended by the manufacturer.

Secondary appliance services have a £10 discount added when done at same time as first appliance.

Gas Fire Service £90 or £80 with boiler service

-Check flue with smoke pellet

- Inspect chimney

- Inspect and clean fire of dust soot and debris

- Check condition of fire

- Check safety devices on fire

- Start fire and check with spillage matches

- Gas rate or burner working pressure of fire test.

Unvented Cylinder Service £75 or £65 with boiler service

- Checking safety devices on cylinder. TPRV PRV Tundishes

- Expansion Vessel or Internal Baffle Plate and correcting when necessary.

- Inspection of leaks.

- Filling out of service booklets for warranty if provided on visit.

Repairs to Gas Apliances, Central Heating Systems and Unvented Hot Water Systems.

First hour is £90, if we repair the problem in this time with no parts used then that's all you will pay, if we need to use a part from our van stock we will advise on the cost of part, if we don't fix on the first visit we will still charge you for the time diagnosing the problem and give you a quote to fully complete the work once the quote is accepted we will order parts and arrange another visit with you. If you don't accept the quote you will only pay the initial £90 for the fist visit. We charge this as we have to allocate enough time to complete the repair on the first visit which we normally do, only the odd occasion we have to revisit with parts. If we only spent up to 30 mins on the first visit we carry over the extra 30 minutes to the next job so if the part required is going to take 1 hour to replace you only be quoted for half an hour of extra labour. Extra hours of labour is charged at £80 and £40 for half hour. Hopefully this covers most of the repair enquiries but if it doesn't please feel free to ask us but let us know by WhatsApp or text that you have sent an enquiry that isn't covered in the automated reply with your email address so we can find your email more easily.

Disconnecting radiators or gas appliances

Disconnecting radiators or Gas fire, Gas cooker/oven/hob is £80 all materials are covered in the price.

Radiators this includes draining system pressure from radiator and capping valves then repressurising system and testing.

Gas appliances requires a gas tightness test before commencing work, then capping appliance with approved method and materials, then re-testing gas supply to ensure no gas leaks are left.

Smart Heating Controls

We fit all types of heating controls but the most common ones we fit are Hive, Drayton Wiser, Tado and Nest. We can supply and fit or fit Customers Own Supplied Smart Thermostat. Prices for our supplied controls are currently.

Hive Heating £260

Hive Mini Heating £220

Drayton Wiser £210

Fit Customers Own single channel (one receiver)£100

If you require a more bespoke system that has extra zones on different floors we can do these but priced on a job to job basis.

Cooker or Hob Installations.

We charge a set price of £140. Contrary to popular belief replacing a cooker or hob is not a 5 minute one in one out job. This includes any materials required to fit the appliance as long as existing gas supply is within 1 metre of location of new appliance. Materials include copper pipe, copper fittings, new cooker hose, stability chain if required ( freestanding cookers) and gas isolation valve ( gas hobs) to comply with current regulations. Testing of whole house gas installation for gas leaks before we start work and after we finish the work and because we turn gas off we are then liable for the other gas appliances in your property we have a duty of care to go round and relight and visually inspect all gas appliances. Then issuing a job completion report.

Landlord/Homeowner Safety Certificates

Similar to the standard boiler service described above plus an extra £10 for the certificate if you have a gas cooker or gas hob we charge no extra for the safety check on this.

Gas fire safety checks are charged at £50 this is different to the standard gas fire service we do. If you prefer to have the gas fire fully serviced it's charged at £80.

Gas fire safety checks include:

Checking catchment space for debris. Smoke testing flue to test integrity of entire flue length including bedroom above and loft space, checking chimney outside on rooftop. Lighting and checking flame picture is safe, checking safety valves gas rate or burner working pressure. And finally spillage testing fire in operation.

Some examples of combination of appliances and charges.

Boiler and Certificate £100

Boiler, Gas Cooker/Hob and Certificate £100

Boiler Gas, Gas Fire, Gas Hob and Certificate £150

Boiler Gas, Gas Fire x2, Gas Hob and Certificate £200

As part of the gas safety check we have to check if you have Carbon Monoxide Alarms fitted in rooms containing gas burning appliances except for cookers/hobs in kitchens. These alarms have to be in date of expiry and in working order. We charge £40 to supply and fit these on request whilst on site and get added to final invoice price.

Hopefully this covers most of the Landlord Gas Safety Certificate enquiries but if it doesn't please feel free to ask us but let us know by WhatsApp or text that you have sent an enquiry that isn't covered in the automated reply with your email address so we can find your email more easily.

Boiler Quotes

We only offer free quotes for boiler replacements and full central heating systems for any repairs we have to diagnose the faults which most of the time can be fixed in the first visit. Boiler Quote booking is only for boiler quotes no tools are used on boiler quotes, if we need to use any tools this is classed as a boiler repair.

Multiple Radiator Quotes

We only do bespoke quotes for multiple radiators not for single radiators we can give estimates via WhatsApp or text for replacing single radiators in same location or close by but we would require the sizes of radiators to be supplied.

Boiler Installations

Boiler Installations can't be booked in via the website we manually agree a date with customer after a signed quotation has been received and then we book it into our diary.

How to book an appointment and best ways to book.

The quickest and easiest way to book is online and below is a step by step guide on how to book online.

Top of website click on click here to book online

This has 2 drop down menu's leave the third one set to Earliest available appointments, prices for the most common types of work will be in the menu's of Appliance Type.

Next page you're presented with a calendar with dates and times available once you pick a date and time you're happy with you go to next page.

After selecting date and time the next page is were you input your customer details. You can add additional information if required at the bottom of the address page. Boiler fault codes, alternative number to ring for access etc...

Then the final screen is to confirm the booking

Confirmations sometimes end up in junk mail so please search there before rebooking another appointment. As we get double booked appointments from time to time and have to contact customer to cancel one of them or customer has to contact us to cancel it. It stops other customers being able to use that timeslot until it's manually cancelled and freed up.

If you are having difficulty in booking online feel free to get in touch with us but be aware if you wait for us to get back to you the appointment may get booked by somebody else in the meantime.

Hopefully this covers everything anything else please contact us.

Regards

Smartech Gas Ltd

messages.text:
Hello Daniel,

I love how you’re pushing AI-powered field service and on-demand style engagement at GoDeskless. Its impressive to see how the platform is reshaping the whole deskless workforce experience across industries like energy and public sector.

Wanted to reach out because I saw you guys at GoDeskless mostly do AI-powered field service management and help enterprises modernize how their deskless teams operate in the field.

Me and my team built an Ai Agent that can find and contact operations, field service, and transformation leaders at mid-market and enterprise companies running large deskless or distributed field teams.

Do you have time for a brief intro in the next few days? Let me know what time suits you and I'll send over a calendar invite.

Thanks,
Mia Malcic
Co-founder @ Mindaptive

messages.subject: RE: quick thought on your interactive demo going live
messages.text:
Hey Daniel,

This might sound a bit odd…
We actually help clients like GoDeskless book meetings with their target customers, but here’s the twist — we only charge when those meetings happen. No setup fees, no catch.

Want me to share a quick walkthrough of how this works in action?

PS: If you dont have a need for more enterprise field service / deskless workforce clients, let me know and I'll step back.

Best,
Mia Malcic
Co-founder @ Mindaptive

messages.text:

Wanted to reach out because I saw you guys at Applied OLAP mostly do spreadsheet management and reporting automation for Oracle EPM and Essbase teams that care about clean, controlled data workflows.

Mia Malcic

Ciao Mia,

scusami se rispondo solo ora alle tue e-Mail, ma sono stato in missione a Washington e sono appena rientrato in Italia.
Ho visto che mi contatti da Pola e dalla Croazia, una città e una nazione che porto nel cuore.
Ho preso visione anche della realtà che rappresenti, molto interessante.

Nel merito della tua richiesta, rispondo in maniera articolata:

1. siamo un ecosistema di innovazione (Harmonic Innovation Ecosystem) che gestisce INNOVIT, il Centro d'Innovazione del governo italiano in Silicon Valley. Accompagniamo startup, PMI innovative e corporate nei percorsi di incubazione, accelerazione e open innovation;
2. gestiamo una infrastruttura materiale e immateriale dedicata alla filiera integrata dell'innovazione che supporta enti governativi e grandi corporate ad affrontare le challenge sfidanti dei nostri tempi;
3. disponiamo di una rete di partner ampia e qualificata: oltre 1.000 partner, 2.000 startup innovative, 150 tech factories (società ICT) socie dell'ecosistema, università e centri di ricerca, boutique della consulenza strategica, agenzie di digital marketing;
4. il nostro piano industriale prevede l'espansione in 30 paesi target, tra cui Europa, Africa, India, Stati Uniti e Sud America, Asia;
5. il modello di aggregazione di imprese ICT è un caso di successo in Italia (82 tech factories con un fatturato aggregato di 500 milioni euro) che vogliamo replicare in altri paesi (Spagna, Francia, Germania, etc.) e in altri continenti (Stati Uniti e Africa in particolare).

Alla luce di quanto sopra riportato, non abbiamo il bisogno di essere accompagnati da fornitori nell'agganciare potenziali clienti. Abbiamo un problema di overflow e non abbiamo esigenze particolari nella fase di ingaggio di prospect. Abbiamo invece bisogno di allargare la rete di partner in ogni paese, con l'obiettivo di promuovere il nostro paradigma dell'Innovazione Armonica (Harmonic Innovation), adottato oggi in molte università italiane e straniere (Madrid, Parigi, etc.).

Mi farebbe piacere riuscire ad avviare una interlocuzione con società croate interessate a dialogare con ecosistemi dell'innovazione.

Ti allego il nostro video di presentazione.

Un cordiale saluto.

Ciao Gennaro,

grazie per la risposta così articolata, e nessun problema per i tempi — spero Washington sia stata produttiva.

Mi hai dato un quadro molto chiaro. Non hai bisogno di agganciare clienti (anzi, overflow), ma di allargare la rete di partner paese per paese. In pratica, far conoscere il paradigma Harmonic Innovation a realtà giuste, in posti giusti.

Il motore che usiamo di solito per acquisizione clienti si adatta perfettamente a questo: trova potenziali partner, fa ricerca su ogni organizzazione, e scrive messaggi personalizzati per aprire conversazioni. L’ho già visto funzionare per costruire pipeline di partnership, non solo commerciali.

Se ti va ne parliamo 20 minuti: posso farti vedere come individueremmo i partner giusti in Croazia (e non solo) e quali risultati potresti aspettarti. Nessuna presentazione, solo per capire se ha senso prima di decidere qualsiasi cosa.

Andrew

Hi Gennaro,

thanks for such a detailed reply, and no worries about the timing — hope Washington was productive.

You gave me a very clear picture. You don’t need to land clients (you’re dealing with overflow, actually), but you do need to expand your partner network country by country. In practice, getting the Harmonic Innovation paradigm in front of the right people, in the right places.

The engine we normally use for client acquisition adapts perfectly to this: it finds potential partners, researches every organization, and writes personalized messages to start conversations. I’ve already seen it work for building partnership pipelines, not just commercial ones.

If you’re up for it, let’s talk 20 minutes: I can show you how we’d identify the right partners in Croatia (and beyond) and what kind of results you could expect. No presentation, just a chance to see if it makes sense before deciding anything.

Welcome back,
Andrew

- Objection handled: The “no need for prospecting” objection is sidestepped by repurposing the engine for partner development rather than clients; his stated desire to connect with Croatian companies reinforces the pivot

Mia,

Thanks for the note.  OpenLegacy is currently evaluating "Lead Onion".  How is does your offering compare?

Hi Carolyn,

Lead Onion is a great tool for the first step of the process: finding potential leads.
The difference is that our service is a complete, end-to-end solution that handles all three steps for you:
We research and find the right people (similar to LeadOnion).

We contact them with a personalized message from our AI.

We book the qualified meeting with potential client directly on your calendar.

So, where LeadOnion gives you a list of names to work on, the key difference is we don't stop there—we also handle the outreach and book the actual meeting with interested customers. It's the full, end-to-end service. And since we only charge for the meetings we book, it's a pretty straightforward, risk-free deal.

We can explain how we would do that for OpenLegacy exactly over a 15-min chat.

- OpenLegacy sells an AI-driven legacy modernization platform that connects mainframes/legacy systems (COBOL, VSAM, CICS, etc.) to modern cloud and API architectures.
- Target customers are large enterprises with heavy legacy tech debt: banks, insurance companies, and other regulated industries needing compliance-safe modernization (GDPR, CCPA, Open Banking).
- Recently expanded distribution via the AWS AI Agents Marketplace (OpenLegacy Hub listing), which was the original icebreaker hook.
- Carolyn is currently evaluating LeadOnion (a competing AI-driven lead gen/outbound tool) for finding and booking enterprise meetings; as of Oct 2025 she reported LeadOnion's results were "less than impressive" but they were still in trial and making adjustments.
- Buying committee context: Carolyn controls or heavily influences the pipeline/lead-gen tooling decision, evaluates vendors head-to-head, and is willing to compare pricing/value models directly.
- She explicitly asked to be recontacted in December (originally referencing Dec 2025) once the LeadOnion trial concludes — good anchor point for next outreach, and worth referencing the trial outcome specifically when following up.
- No review-signal or website-inbound-volume diagnostics apply here; this is a B2B tech firm being sold Mindaptive's own outbound-as-a-service offering (Reach), not an Acquire/Convert inbound product.

I am Mia, co-founder of Mindaptive. We work with B2B businesses to predictably fill their pipeline with qualified clients using smart outbound systems and AI automation.

Hey Ben,
Let me be specific.
We run the entire outbound engine for B2B firms that need more qualified meetings. Here’s what that looks like for a company like Digica:
We pull a list of companies that fit your ideal customer profile, say, mid-market engineering teams stuck in proof-of-concept hell.
An AI system researches each one, reading their site and news, and filters out anyone who’s not a real match.
For the ones that pass, we look at the specific decision-maker’s LinkedIn activity and write a unique email just for them. Not a template with the name swapped.
We send through Smartlead, and another AI handles the replies to keep the conversation going until a meeting is on your calendar.

No mass spam. No generic blasts. Each email is written to one person about what they actually care about.
We do this on performance. If we don’t deliver leads you’re happy to take, you don’t pay a cent.
I’d suggest a 30-minute call so I can show you how we’d find the right engineering leads for Digica and give you exact pricing based on your volume. No commitment, just a look under the hood.

Ciao Roberto,

Mi fa piacere che tu abbia "sgamato" subito l'AI agent. Hai occhio! Essendo del settore, apprezzerai la trasparenza tecnica.

Ecco le risposte sul nostro framework:

1. Tech Stack & Orchestrazione: A differenza di molte agenzie che usano tool standard (come Clay), noi abbiamo costruito un'orchestrazione proprietaria. Usiamo agenti AI interni sviluppati da noi per gestire l'intero flusso di ricerca e scrittura.

2. Data Collection & Scraping: Per la base dati utilizziamo database solidi come Apollo, ma il vero valore è nel "layer" successivo: i nostri agenti navigano in tempo reale per arricchire i dati con informazioni contestuali che i database statici non hanno.

3. Modelli AI: Siamo "model agnostic". Non ci leghiamo a un solo provider. I nostri agenti utilizzano dinamicamente il modello migliore per il task specifico—che sia ChatGPT, Gemini o Claude—in base a quale performa meglio per il reasoning o il copywriting in quel momento.

4. Costi Operativi (Unit Economics): Il costo per generare 1.000 contatti varia, ma la cosa fondamentale è questa: tu non te ne devi preoccupare.Lavorando a Performance (Pay-per-Lead), noi ci assumiamo interamente il rischio operativo e i costi delle API/modelli. Tu non paghi per la lista o per lo scraping, ma solo per le risposte positive che ti portiamo.

Se ti va di vedere come girano i nostri agenti nel backend, possiamo fare una call veloce.

Company size and profile.

My team acts as an extension of Aionys, using specialized tools to ensure high-quality, relevant data for personalization.
We build lists of companies that match the precise profile defined above.

Crucially, we enrich each lead with enough context to write a highly relevant message (role, current tech stack, specific use case, company news, etc.).

We run the outreach as if we were your in-house SDR team, ensuring quality and brand consistency.
Cold emails are written 1-to-1, not as generic templates, leveraging real-time data.

Everything is sent from your domains/inboxes, maintaining your positioning and tone of voice.

The message always ties back to what you actually do: custom software, full-cycle delivery, healthcare expertise, etc.

We only deliver warm leads to your sales team, maximizing their efficiency.
When someone shows interest, we perform a light qualification.

Seamless Hand-off: We pass them to the preferred contact person on your side.

You retain full ownership of all generated leads and data.

Which verticals and messages bring the best replies.

Where deals actually move forward.

Finding Your Clients: We start by identifying mid-size companies that fit your ideal profile – specifically those using Salesforce and likely needing better sales processes or consulting, based on various online signals (tech stack, recent company news, etc.).

AI-Powered Outreach: Our agent then researches each specific prospect (e.g., the Head of Sales, VP of Operations) in real-time and writes a hyper-personalized email. This isn't a template; it's crafted individually to resonate with their specific situation and pitch RaagviTech's value.

Booking Qualified Meetings: When a prospect shows interest, we handle the initial back-and-forth and book a qualified meeting directly into your calendar. You only get introduced when someone is ready to talk seriously about Salesforce solutions.

Regarding results, our model is entirely performance-based. We typically aim to book a consistent number of qualified meetings each month, and you only pay for those successfully booked meetings. This ensures the focus is always on quality and ROI, not just volume.

The person attends the call (no-shows aren’t billed),

Hoi,

Ik zag op jullie website dat jullie al meer dan 7.000 tevreden klanten hebben en ook werken met batterijen, laadpalen en energiemanagement. Mooi hoe breed jullie dit aanpakken.

Net een build afgerond voor een zonnepanelen-installateur in Berlijn. Hun team was bijna 3 uur per dag kwijt aan het beantwoorden van dezelfde vragen via WhatsApp en e-mail. Reactietijd teruggebracht tot onder de 4 minuten, 24 uur per dag. Ze boekten in de eerste 6 weken 11 extra geboekte locatiebezoeken.

Ik doe dit specifiek voor zonnepanelenbedrijven. Ik bouw een AI die elke vraag 24/7 afhandelt via telefoon, WhatsApp, e-mail en websitechat. Hij kwalificeert elke lead en boekt ze direct in uw agenda zonder dat iemand in uw team eraan hoeft te zitten. Ik bouw het geheel voor uw bedrijf zonder vooraf kosten en heb het binnen 14 dagen live. Als u het na 30 dagen de moeite waard vindt om te houden, kunnen we samenwerken.

Ik heb een clip van 2 minuten waarin een echte zonnepanelenvraag van begin tot eind wordt afgehandeld. Reageer en ik stuur hem door.

Met vriendelijke groet,

messages.subject: phoenix + shoptalk energy + bold metrics
messages.text:
Hello Jackson,

I saw that post you reposted from Jeff about the Shoptalk events Bold Metrics is throwing. The energy around those mixers with all those brands sounds like the kind of thing that actually moves business.

Anyways, figured I'd reach out because I saw you guys at Bold Metrics mostly work with apparel brands and retailers trying to reduce returns and boost conversion. I built an Agent that can find and contact heads of ecommerce and merchandising at mid-to-large apparel retailers who'd benefit from what you do.

If that sounds interesting let me know and I'll record a 3-min video for you showing how we would do it for Bold Metrics.

PS: If you don't have a need for apparel retailers right now, let me know and I'll step back.

Best regards,
Mia Malčić
Co-Founder @ Mindaptive.ai

Hi Mia,

Thanks for reaching out. That does sound interesting—feel free to send over the video and I'll take a look.

Best,
Jackson

- Target buyers: heads of ecommerce, merchandising, digital product, and marketing at mid‑to‑large apparel retailers.

- No visible outbound sales motion (no SDR/BDR hiring signals); founder‑led sales likely.
- Reviews: typical for a B2B SaaS, not a local‑service business; review count on Google is irrelevant.

Hello Mia,

Will Mindaptive AI map all required fields (like customer referral source, site notes, and emergency flags) directly into WEX FSM? Additionally, will it be able to handle live appointment booking?

Diamond Heating & Cooling Services, Inc
Derien Gee-President

Hello Derien,

Yes on both.

The agent collects every field while it talks to the customer: referral source, site notes, emergency flag, equipment and the job itself. It asks for anything missing while talking with the customer, so nothing arrives half filled in (name, address, etc..). Those fields write straight into WEX FSM through our Zapier connection, so the customer record is already complete when your team opens it.

On booking, the agent takes the appointment with the customer and it lands in WEX with the time and the job details attached, ready for dispatch to put on the board. Writing straight onto the WEX calendar itself needs API access on your account, which we can also request from WEX together with you.

Here is how the process works:

When a customer is finished talking with the agent, the agent saves the data to the database.
It then connects to WEX FSM, sends the data and creates the record automatically.
Optionally, the agent can also notify your team that a new lead or inquiry just arrived. We usually send that on Slack, Teams, email, WhatsApp or any other communication platform your team uses. This can also be sent conditionally, for example an emergency repair.

Hope this was helpful.
Mia

Hi Jesse,
Helemaal begrijpelijk. Laat me kort uitleggen hoe het werkt.
De AI-agent die ik heb gebouwd is getraind op je website, je behandelingen, je prijzen en je servicegebied. Als iemand je belt, een WhatsApp-bericht stuurt, een formulier invult of een e-mail stuurt, vangt de agent dit op en antwoordt meteen in dezelfde taal.
Hij vraagt wat de patiënt nodig heeft (type behandeling, locatievoorkeur, of het een spoedgeval is). Als de persoon gekwalificeerd is, boekt hij direct een afspraak in je Calendly-kalender. Is de persoon niet gekwalificeerd (buiten je gebied, verkeerde verwachting), dan wijst de agent deze beleefd af.
Je team ziet dan elke ochtend alleen de serieuze leads, klaar om te bellen of te kwalificeren. Geen gepieker over wie er wanneer antwoord geeft.
Het is gekoppeld aan je bestaande systemen (Calendly, WhatsApp Business, je contactformulier), dus geen nieuwe logins of rompslomp. En omdat je op 6 locaties zit, kan hij ook slim routeren: patiënt in Utrecht → formulier naar je Utrecht-team, enz.
Voor Ortho-Clear betekent dit dat jullie geen enkele aanvraag meer mislopen, omdat het systeem 24/7 draait. Patiënten hoeven niet meer te wachten op antwoord op hun vragen. Bovendien werkt de AI-spraakagent als een perfect vangnet: hij neemt de telefoon pas op wanneer jouw team een oproep mist, zodat er geen enkele kans meer verloren gaat.
Ik kan dit in een call veel beter laten zien, met een live voorbeeld van hoe hij met potentiële patiënten praat. Maar als je eerst even wat meer wilt zien, stuur ik graag een demovideo van 3 minuten. Ik kan natuurlijk ook je specifieke vragen via e-mail beantwoorden.

messages.text:
Γεια σας,

This is meant for whoever runs the practice. Would you mind passing it on?

Είδα το site σας και παρατήρησα ότι κάνετε εξειδικευμένη νοσηλεία, επεμβάσεις και εργαστηριακές εξετάσεις. Φαντάζομαι ότι πολλοί ιδιοκτήτες ζητάνε εκτιμήσεις και σχέδια θεραπείας για τα κατοικίδιά τους, αλλά πολλοί από αυτούς δεν επιστρέφουν ποτέ για να κλείσουν την επίσκεψη.
Έφτιαξα ένα απλό σύστημα που αναλαμβάνει αυτούς τους ασθενείς μόνο του μετά την πρόταση. Κάνει follow up, απαντάει σε τυχόν απορίες που έχουν μείνει και τους παροτρύνει να κλείσουν ραντεβού πριν χάσουν το ενδιαφέρον ή πάνε αλλού. Ένας πελάτης μου ανέκτησε 9 ραντεβού τον περασμένο μήνα, από προτάσεις που αλλιώς θα είχαν ξεχαστεί.
Απαντήστε σε αυτό το email και θα σας πω περισσότερα για το πώς το χρησιμοποιούν ήδη κάποια ιατρεία.
Με εκτίμηση,
Mia Malčić
Co-founder @ Mindaptive.ai

lead.research_summary:
- AP Rescue, s.r.o. (Bratislava-Petržalka) provides professional medical/first-aid supervision at cultural, social, corporate, and sporting events (up to 50,000 attendees), plus accredited first-aid courses (including CPR/VR training) and rental/sale of medical equipment (AEDs etc.).
- On the market since 2019; claims 1,200+ patients treated, 2,000+ people trained in first aid, and coverage of 4,000+ events.
- Client/reference list skews toward sports and media: Slovan Bratislava HC, Slovak Football/Handball/Tennis/Karate federations, TV JOJ, RTVS, Závodisko Bratislava — suggests B2B relationships with event organizers, sports clubs, and broadcasters rather than direct-to-consumer patients.
- Business model is quote-driven: organizers submit event details (location, expected attendance, duration) via phone, email, or contact form to get a custom price; pricing is always individualized per event.
- Competitive landscape is crowded — several near-identical Slovak "event medical supervision" companies exist (Slovak Rescue, Rescue MM, Rescue Považie, rescueASSISTANCE), meaning organizers likely request quotes from multiple providers simultaneously — speed and quality of first response is a real differentiator.
- Decision-maker/contact: Peter Lakomý (peter.lakomy@aprescue.sk, +421910976134), signs as representing AP Rescue s.r.o. Two separate phone numbers are listed on the site (contact number and a second mobile), no visible live chat or speed-of-response guarantee on the quote/contact page. No meaningful public review signal to leverage (not a consumer review business).
- Engagement history: replied "yes send more info" on 7/9 and received the detailed speed-to-lead pitch on 7/16; a prototype demo was sent 7/21 and a missed meeting was re-engaged 8/6. Peter replied 8/6 apologizing and asking to reschedule for the following week.

messages.text:
Hej Hanna,

Jeg kom ind i det her, fordi en veninde, der driver en klinik, hele tiden brokkede sig over, at forpassede henvendelser blev til tabte patienter, så jeg byggede noget til hende, og det tog lidt af derfra.

Jeg arbejder med mange klinikker i disse dage, og mønstret er altid det samme: en henvendelse kommer ind, ingen er til rådighed til at svare med det samme, og den kunde ringer bare til det næste sted på listen. Jeg satte et system op for at løse det for én klinik, og de fik booket 17 ekstra aftaler inden for deres første 40 dage.

Jeg sætter et system op, der svarer på ubesvarede opkald og webhenvendelser inden for 3 minutter, dag som nat, og får dem direkte ind i din kalender. Jeg bygger det gratis, og hvis det ikke genererer 10 aftaler på 40 dage, betaler du ikke en krone.

Har du tid til en 15-min snak i denne uge, så vi kan se nærmere på det?

Med venlig hilsen
Mia Malcic
Co-founder @ Mindaptive

Ich richte dir ein System ein, das entgangene Anrufe und Web-Anfragen innerhalb von 3 Minuten beantwortet – Tag und Nacht – und die Termine direkt in deinen Kalender bucht. - Core services: comprehensive cardiac investigations for pets referred by general vets (Doppler echocardiography, blood tests, X-rays, ECGs) and breed screening (annual heart testing) for breeders, including Kennel Club assured breeders.
- Target customers are two-sided: referring general veterinary practices sending patients in, and dog/cat breeders needing recurring annual heart screening.
- Small team. Prior admin contact Mike Smith has left the practice; new point of contact is Laura Blakeley. No direct email for Laura yet, only reachable via mike@cheshirecardiology.com (auto-forwarded) or main line 01606 827188.

I put together a short video showing how clinics handle this with a secretary that answers the phone (and WhatsApp and the website) after hours, plus a follow‑up system that chases treatment plans without anyone having to remember. It’s here if you’d like a look: https://www.loom.com/share/456990f4664d4d44b310f0b98d38ed8c

If it seems useful, I’m happy to jump on a quick call and show you a prototype built for Cheshire Cardio specifically. No pressure, no pitch, just a chance for you to see if it makes sense before deciding anything.

Cheers,
Andrew

messages.subject: ako kliniky získavajú viac pacientov
messages.text:
Dobrý deň Michal,

Dostal som sa k tomu, lebo kamarátka, ktorá vedie ambulanciu, sa stále sťažovala, že jej zmeškané dopyty menia na stratených pacientov, tak som jej niečo vytvoril a nejako sa to odtiaľ rozbehlo.

V súčasnosti spolupracujem s mnohými ambulanciami a ten vzorec je vždy rovnaký: príde dopyt, nikto nie je hneď k dispozícii, aby naň odpovedal, a ten záujemca jednoducho zavolá na ďalšie miesto v zozname. Pre jednu ambulanciu som nastavil systém, ktorý to rieši, a počas prvých 40 dní si objednali 17 návštev navyše.

Nastavím vám systém, ktorý do 3 minút odpovie na zmeškané hovory a dopyty z webu, cez deň aj v noci, a dostane ich rovno do vášho kalendára. Postavím ho zadarmo, a ak za 40 dní nevygeneruje 10 návštev, nezaplatíte ani cent.

Stačí mi rýchle áno a pošlem vám viac informácií o tom, ako by to fungovalo.

S pozdravom
Mia Malčić
Co-Founder @ Mindaptive.ai

messages.subject: vraag over boekingsproces
messages.text:
Hallo,

Ik was geïnteresseerd in tandartspraktijken rond Amstelveen en kwam Gebitszorg tegen. Ik zag dat jullie mondhygiëne aanbieden en jullie krijgen vast elke dag aardig wat aanvragen binnen.

Ik wilde contact opnemen omdat ik werk met klinieken vergelijkbaar met de jouwe, waarbij ik hen help no-show afspraken te verminderen. Vorige maand verminderde een tandheelkundige kliniek in Zagreb het no-show percentage met 30% met onze afspraakherinneringen workflow.

Ik zet een systeem op dat je patiënten automatisch herinnert aan hun afspraak. Ik laat je het 30 dagen geheel kosteloos draaien. Zodat je kunt zien hoe het werkt voor Gebitszorg

Geef me een snel ja en ik stuur je meer info over hoe dit zou werken.

Met vriendelijke groet
Mia Malčić
Co-Founder @ Mindaptive.ai

messages.text:
Hello,

I was interested in dental practices around Bedford MK41 9NS and came across Chrysalis Dental. saw that you offer nhs dental care and must get quite a few inquiries on a daily basis.

Mia Malčić

name: Erich
company: Ecom - Praxis Für Orthopädie, Sportmedizin Und Unfallchirurgie
preview:
Sehr geehrte Patientin, sehr geehrter Patient,
sehr geehrte Damen und Herren,

Dr. med. Erich Rembeck ist zum Jahreswechsel bei ECOM - Praxis für Orthopädie, Sportmedizin & Gelenkchirurgie - Ärztepart

messages.subject: Wie Kliniken mehr Patienten gewinnen
messages.text:
Hallo Erich,

Ich bin da reingerutscht, weil eine Freundin, die eine Praxis führt, sich ständig über verpasste Anfragen beschwert hat, aus denen dann verlorene Patienten wurden. Also habe ich ihr etwas gebaut, und das hat sich von da an irgendwie verselbstständigt.

Ich arbeite inzwischen mit vielen Praxen zusammen, und das Muster ist immer dasselbe: Eine Anfrage kommt rein, niemand ist gerade da, um sofort zu antworten, und dieser Interessent ruft einfach beim Nächsten auf der Liste an. Für eine Praxis habe ich ein System eingerichtet, das genau das behebt, und sie haben in ihren ersten 40 Tagen 17 zusätzliche Termine gebucht.

Ich richte Ihnen ein System ein, das auf verpasste Anrufe und Web-Anfragen innerhalb von 3 Minuten reagiert, Tag und Nacht, und sie direkt in Ihren Kalender bringt. Ich baue es gratis auf, und wenn es in 40 Tagen keine 10 Termine bringt, zahlen Sie keinen Cent.

Geben Sie mir kurz ein Ja, und ich schicke Ihnen mehr Infos dazu, wie das funktionieren würde.

Viele Grüße
Mia Malcic
Co-founder @ Mindaptive

Sehr geehrte Patientin, sehr geehrter Patient,
sehr geehrte Damen und Herren,

Dr. med. Erich Rembeck ist zum Jahreswechsel bei ECOM - Praxis für Orthopädie, Sportmedizin & Gelenkchirurgie - Ärztepartnerschaft ausgeschieden und nicht mehr für unser Unternehmen tätig.

Ihre E-Mail wird nicht automatisch weitergeleitet.

Den sportorthopädischen Bereich in unserer Praxis führt der längjährige Partner Dr. med. Alexander Rauch gemeinsam mit Privatdozent Dr. med. Julian Mehl als Nachfolger von Dr. Rembeck weiter.

Im Bereich Endoprothetik (Hüft- und Kniegelenkersatz) stehen unverändert Prof. Dr. med. Hans Gollwitzer und Prof. Dr. med. Patrick Weber für Sie zur Verfügung.

Die Fußchirurgie und Sprunggelenkendoprothetik führt Prof. Dr. med. Norbert Harrasser als neuer Partner bei ECOM weiter.

Unsere konservativen Ärzte, Frau Dr. med. Frauke Schallner und Herr Dr. med. Sebastian Kieslich, runden unser orthopädisches Spektrum für Sie ab.

Bitte richten Sie Terminanfragen an unser Team: termine@ecom-muenchen.de
Allgemeine Anfragen können Sie gerne unter info@ecom-muenchen.de an uns richten.

Telefonisch stehen wird zu unseren Sprechzeiten unter 089 - 92 333 94 - 0 gerne zur Verfügung.

Herzlichen Dank für Ihre Treue
Ihr ECOM-Team

messages.subject: de klus die naar een ander ging
messages.text:
Hoi,

Ik zag op jullie website dat jullie inzetten op betaalbare zonnepanelen en een complete installatie. Mooie, nuchtere aanpak, zeker voor mensen die gewoon goed geholpen willen worden.

Ik wilde u laten weten dat ik samenwerk met zonnepanelen-installateurs door de hele EU. Laatste klant ging van 6 locatiebezoeken per maand naar 17. Ongeveer 28.5k eur aan klussen die hij anders gemist zou hebben.

De oplossing is eigenlijk een Agent die op elke vraag reageert binnen 5 minuten, op elk moment van de dag. Leads kwalificeren en ervoor zorgen dat bedrijven geen dure installatieopdracht meer mislopen.

Laat me weten of u het 30 dagen wilt proberen. Als het niet doet wat ik zei, kunt u opzeggen en bent u niets verschuldigd. Ik neem 2 of 3 klanten per maand aan omdat ik elke build zelf doe.
Reageer en ik stuur een clip van 2 minuten waarin u ziet hoe hij een echte zonnepanelenvraag afhandelt.

Met vriendelijke groet,
Mia Malcic
Co-founder @ Mindaptive

Goedendag,
Na lang wikken en wegen hebben we helaas moeten besluiten om na 13 jaar te stoppen in de zonnepanelenbranche. We zijn begonnen als Sunnyfix in 2012.
In 2019 moesten we onze bedrijfsnaam wijzigen, dat is ElectriSun geworden, maar met hetzelfde team.
Door de huidige ontwikkelingen is er momenteel weinig vraag naar zonnepanelen. Daarnaast is goed advies op de iets langere termijn wat ons betreft heel ingewikkeld geworden.
We willen al onze klanten bedanken voor het vertrouwen en de fijne samenwerking!
Mocht u onverhoopt een storing hebben dan kunt u een e-mail sturen naar: zonnepanelen@beterbouwadvies.nl
Een van onze voormalige installateurs kan u hier dan wellicht vanuit zijn eigen bedrijf mee helpen en eventuele productgarantie regelen.
Hij doet dit naast zijn andere werkzaamheden, dus houdt u rekening met langere wachttijden. (De installatiegarantie komt helaas te vervallen)

messages.subject: affären du förlorade förra veckan
messages.text:
Hej,

Jag såg på er sajt att ni har samlat sol, batteri, elbilsladdning och smart styrning under Soltech Home. Snyggt gjort, särskilt efter bytet från Sesol.

Precis avslutat ett bygge åt en solinstallatör i Berlin. Deras team höll på att bränna nästan 3 timmar om dagen på att bara svara på samma frågor via WhatsApp och mejl. Vi pressade ner deras svarstid till under 4 minuter, dygnet runt. De drog in 11 extra bokade platsbesök under de första 6 veckorna.

Jag gör det här specifikt för solföretag. Bygger en AI som hanterar varje förfrågan 24/7 via samtal, WhatsApp, mejl och webbchatt. Den kvalificerar varje lead och bokar in dem direkt i din kalender utan att någon i ditt team behöver lyfta ett finger. Jag bygger hela grejen för ditt företag utan någon förskottskostnad och har den live inom 14 dagar. Om du tycker att den är värd att behålla efter 30 dagar kan vi jobba ihop.

Har ett 2-minutersklipp där den hanterar en riktig solförfrågan från start till slut. Svara så skickar jag över den.

Allt gott,
Mia Malcic
Co-founder @ Mindaptive

Alla som anmäler en fordran i konkursen kommer att informeras om huruvida det blir någon utdelning senare i konkursen. messages.subject: hjälp för era samtal
messages.text:
Hej,

Jag såg på er webbplats att ni hjälper kunder med solpaneler, batterier och laddboxar, plus personliga möten. Det känns som ett riktigt bra upplägg.

Ville bara höra med dig om du stöter på samma problem som majoriteten av de solföretag vi har träffat på. Oftast handlar det om att man inte hinner svara på kundförfrågningar i tid, eller att man lägger en massa tid på att manuellt kvalificera leads. Oavsett om det sker via mobil, mejl eller whatsapp.

Vi löser det genom att bygga röst- och chattagenter för solföretag. Den pratar med kunder, kvalificerar var och en och sparar dem i ditt CRM (som ServiceTitan). Den är kopplad till din kalender och ditt mejl. Våra kunder brukar tjäna in ungefär 25hrs varje vecka med den här metoden.

Svara bara ett snabbt ja så skickar jag en 4-minutersvideo som visar hur agenten hanterar solförfrågningar.

Allt gott,
Mia Malcic
Co-founder @ Mindaptive

messages.subject: interesado en tu trabajo
messages.text:
Hola,

Vi no vosso site que vocês fazem projeto, fornecimento e instalação de painéis sandwich. Gosto muito dessa forma de trabalhar, porque mostra bastante controlo do processo.

Quería escribirte para ver si te pasa lo mismo que a la mayoría de las empresas solares con las que hemos hablado. Suele ser no poder responder a las consultas de los clientes a tiempo o perder mucho tiempo calificando leads manualmente. Ya sea por móvil, email o WhatsApp.

Lo solucionamos creando Agentes de Voz y Chat para empresas solares. Conversa con los clientes, califica a cada uno y los guarda en tu CRM (como ServiceTitan). Está conectado a tu calendario y a tu email. Nuestros clientes suelen recuperar unas 25hrs cada semana con este enfoque.

Dime que sí en breve y te envío un vídeo de 4 minutos en el que se ve cómo el agente gestiona consultas solares.

Un saludo,
Mia Malcic
Co-founder @ Mindaptive

Hej,

Jag såg på er sida att ni hanterar både solceller, batterier och laddlösningar från första kontakt till färdig installation. Det är imponerande att hålla ihop hela kedjan så bra.

Precis avslutat ett bygge åt en solinstallatör i Berlin. Deras team höll på att bränna nästan 3 timmar om dagen på att bara svara på samma frågor via WhatsApp och mejl. Vi pressade ner deras svarstid till under 4 minuter, dygnet runt. De drog in 11 extra bokade platsbesök under de första 6 veckorna.

Jag gör det här specifikt för solföretag. Bygger en AI som hanterar varje förfrågan 24/7 via samtal, WhatsApp, mejl och webbchatt. Den kvalificerar varje lead och bokar in dem direkt i din kalender utan att någon i ditt team behöver lyfta ett finger. Jag bygger hela grejen för ditt företag utan någon förskottskostnad och har den live inom 14 dagar. Om du tycker att den är värd att behålla efter 30 dagar kan vi jobba ihop.

Har ett 2-minutersklipp där den hanterar en riktig solförfrågan från start till slut. Svara så skickar jag över den.

Allt gott,
Andrew Juran
Co-Founder @ Mindaptive.ai

Hej!
Tack för ditt mejl.  Vi vill informera om att Sesol AB har försatts i konkurs den 17 mars.
Detta innebär att det inte längre är möjligt att nå supporten på Sesol.
Situationen är naturligtvis beklaglig och vi förstår att olägenheter kan uppstå. För frågor om din anläggning gällande garantier och reklamationer, vänligen kontakta tillverkaren av produkterna.
Konkursboet har ingått avtal om verksamhetsöverlåtelse avseende merparten av tillgångarna i Sesol AB med köparen SVEA renewable solar AB (”Svea Solar”). Överlåtelsen är villkorad av att erforderliga anmälningar görs till berörda myndigheten samt att nödvändiga godkännanden inhämtas. Svea Solar kommer därefter att ta vidare integrationen av de förvärvade tillgångarna. Ytterligare information kommer gå direkt till berörda kunder.
Läs mer om konkursen här:
Soltech-koncernens information: [link: https://soltechenergy.com/information-konkurs-i-sesol-ab/] https://soltechenergy.com/information-konkurs-i-sesol-ab/

Konkursförvaltarens information: [link: https://cirio.se/news/sesol] https://cirio.se/news/sesol.
Information från förvärvande organisation: [link: https://sveasolar.se/sv-se/press/acquisition-sesol] https://sveasolar.se/sv-se/press/acquisition-sesol

Ni som har en driftsatt anläggning kan få snabba svar på vanliga frågor här nedan:

Kommer min anläggning påverkas av konkursen?
Din anläggning kommer inte att påverkas per automatik av konkursen. Anläggningen fortsätter att fungera som vanligt.
Jag har ett tekniskt fel på min anläggning – vad gör jag?
I och med att supporten inte kan vara behjälplig hänvisar vi dig till tillverkaren, alternativt får felet göras gällande som ett krav i konkursen genom att du fyller i ett formulär om fordran: [link: https://cirio.se/news/sesol] https://cirio.se/news/sesol
Hur fungerar det med produktgarantier på produkter?
För reklamationer av felaktiga produkter kan du vända dig direkt till tillverkaren som utfärdar garantin så får dom undersöka ärendet. Om ersättning inte kan erhållas från tillverkaren får kravet på ersättning göras gällande som ett krav i konkursen genom formuläret i länken: [link: https://cirio.se/news/sesol] https://cirio.se/news/sesol.
Vad händer med installationsgarantin?
Installationsgarantier som kunder gör anspråk på kommer inte att kunna infrias inom ramen för konkursen utan får i sådant fall anmälas som en fordran i konkursen via [link: https://cirio.se/news/sesol] https://cirio.se/news/sesol..
Om jag anmäler en fordran i konkursen – när får jag betalt?
Huruvida det blir utdelning i konkursen, så att borgenärer får ersättning (helt eller delvis) för sin fordran, beror på flera faktorer. Det är för tidigt att säga om det blir någon utdelning. Alla som anmäler en fordran i konkursen kommer att informeras om huruvida det blir någon utdelning senare i konkursen. På denna sida hittar du ett formulär för eventuell fordran: [link: https://cirio.se/news/sesol] https://cirio.se/news/sesol

messages.text:
Hi Infinity Heating team,

Saw that Infinity Heating covers both gas work and plumbing across Glasgow. Nice mix of services, and the Gas Safe and ATAG Partner creds stand out.

I wanted to reach out because we build AI Agents for HVAC and plumbing companies. Last month our client added 53k euro in additional revenue using one of our AI workflows.

I would like to build an AI secretary for Infinity Heating, completely no charge. It answers calls, chats with customers on WhatsApp, qualifies them, and saves everything for your team. Zero time needed from you until it's ready to test.

Reply "yes" and I will send a 4-min video demo showing how the secretary takes calls for HVAC and plumbing companies.

Kind regards,
Mia Malcic
Co-founder @ Mindaptive

Dear Valued Customers and Partners,
We hope this message finds you well. We wanted to inform you of a crucial update regarding our communication channels.
Effective immediately, we have made changes to our email addresses to enhance our responsiveness and efficiency in serving you better.
For all finance-related and payment enquiries, please direct your emails to our new dedicated email account: accounts@infinityheating.co.uk. Our finance team will promptly address any queries regarding invoices, payments, or financial matters through this channel.
Please note that all previous email accounts will no longer be actively monitored for these purposes due to this transition.
Additionally, for all other inquiries, including general questions, customer support needs, or administrative matters, we have set up a new central email address: admin@infinityheating.co.uk. Our team will address all non-finance-related correspondence through this channel.
We apologise for any inconvenience this change may cause and kindly ask you to update your records with our new email addresses to ensure seamless communication.
Your continued support is invaluable to us, and we remain committed to providing you with the best service possible.
Should you have any questions or need further assistance, please do not hesitate to reach out to the appropriate email addresses mentioned above.
Thank you for your understanding and cooperation during this transition period.
Warm regards,
Infinity Heating
01412660097

Infinity Heating and Plumbing

Mobile: 07817 935 058

Hallo Nils,

freut mich, dass wir im Gespräch sind!
Um deine größte Sorge direkt vorwegzunehmen: Es geht hier absolut nicht um KI-Cold-Calls. Niemand mag das, und wir machen das auch nicht.

Unser Fokus liegt zu 100 % auf euren Inbound-Anfragen. Stell dir unsere KI vielmehr als eure perfekte, stets verfügbare Sekretärin vor, die euch extrem viel Arbeit und Stress abnimmt.

Hier ist ein typisches Szenario, wie wir euren Alltag erleichtern:
Es ist Hochsaison, bei euch klingelt ständig das Telefon, aber alle Mitarbeiter sind in Gesprächen oder auf Montage. Oder es ist schlichtweg nach Feierabend. Ein Interessent ruft an, weil er ein Balkonkraftwerk kaufen will. Anstatt in der Warteschleife oder auf dem Anrufbeantworter zu landen (was oft dazu führt, dass Kunden auflegen und beim nächsten Konkurrenten anrufen), geht unsere KI nach dem ersten Klingeln ran.

Sie klingt extrem natürlich – wie ein echter Mitarbeiter aus Köln. Sie beantwortet grundlegende Fragen zu euren Anlagen, fragt gezielt nach, was der Kunde genau sucht, und nimmt seine Kontaktdaten auf.
Und hier kommt die Automatisierung ins Spiel, die euch Zeit spart: Nach dem Auflegen fasst die KI das komplette Gespräch zusammen und schiebt alle Daten direkt in euer CRM oder schickt euch eine strukturierte E-Mail/WhatsApp-Nachricht. Sie kann sogar direkt einen Rückruftermin im Kalender eures Vertriebsteams buchen. Wenn ihr morgens ins Büro kommt, habt ihr bereits vorqualifizierte Leads auf dem Tisch, ohne eine Sekunde am Telefon verschwendet zu haben. Euch rutscht kein einziger Kunde mehr durch die Lappen.
Was die Kosten angeht: Das hängt davon ab, welche Systeme (z. B. Kalender, CRM) wir für euch anbinden sollen.

Lass uns doch nächste Woche einfach für 10-15 Minuten sprechen. Wir können das gerne über Google Meet machen – hier ist der Link, über den du dir direkt einen passenden Termin aussuchen kannst: [link: https://calendar.app.google/XxXsMrp8PWktdBZm6] https://calendar.app.google/XxXsMrp8PWktdBZm6

Alternativ können wir uns auch ganz unkompliziert über WhatsApp oder telefonisch unter +385 97 766 9883 hören, ganz wie es dir am besten passt.

In dem kurzen Gespräch zeige ich dir live, wie verblüffend echt die KI am Telefon klingt, und wir können direkt besprechen, wie ein Setup und die genauen Kosten für Solarenergie Köln aussehen würden.

Viele Grüße,
Andrew

Hi Andrew, hi Mia,

Apologies for not getting back to you on your proposal earlier, and thank you for putting
it together.

We are now revisiting lead generation at Next Digital Group, with a different focus. Your
original proposal was tailored to the Public, Energy and Utility sectors. Our current priority is to generate new business for our
Data Intelligence services in the DACH market.

Our offering covers:

Tracking & Web Analytics: establishing reliable data collection and turning website and marketing data into actionable insights.

Marketing Performance Strategy & Execution: developing and executing data-driven marketing strategies, optimising campaigns and budgets, and measuring their business impact.

Website Optimization & Conversion Rate Optimization: improving website performance, usability and conversion through analysis and testing.

Customer Journey Analysis: understanding customer behaviour across touchpoints and identifying opportunities to improve the customer experience.

Data Platforms: connecting data sources and building platforms for reporting, analytics and business decisions.

Data Strategy & Governance: defining data roadmaps, responsibilities and standards for data quality and effective use.

Data Literacy: enabling teams to understand, interpret and use data confidently in their daily work.

AI Strategy, Governance & Use Cases: identifying valuable AI applications, defining an implementation roadmap and establishing appropriate governance.

We are particularly interested in highly personalised, AI-supported outreach that identifies
relevant companies and decision-makers based on concrete business signals. These might include a website relaunch, the expansion of a data team, a platform migration or a new AI initiative. Depending on the service, we would target marketing, e-commerce, analytics,
data, IT or transformation leaders.

For an initial pilot, we would be open to focusing on a specific part of this portfolio
and a clearly defined target segment.

Could you see SparkSender working well for this offering? It would be helpful to understand
whether you have experience with similar consulting services and how you would approach targeting and personalisation for us.

Could you also let us know whether the original commercial terms are still available?

Kick-off Call (60 mins): After our team has compiled all the data and built the first draft of the outreach script, we finalize the strategy, confirm the final price per meeting, and launch the campaign.

After the Kick-off, our team handles all the heavy lifting—you just show up to the qualified meetings.

Hallo Andrew,

vielen Dank für deine Nachricht und die Einführung. Der Ansatz klingt grundsätzlich interessant für uns bei ins-pi, insbesondere da wir mit Transformation-Leads, Enterprise-Architektur-Teams und IT-Entscheidern arbeiten, die große Veränderungsinitiativen auf
ServiceNow vorantreiben.

Bevor wir einen Termin ansetzen, würde ich gerne ein klareres Verständnis dafür bekommen, wie eure Lösung genau funktioniert und ob sie zu unserer Wachstums- und Outreach-Strategie passt (Telefon, E-Mail, LinkedIn – mit HubSpot als zentrale CRM-Plattform).
Unser Fokus liegt dabei primär auf englischsprachigen Zielgruppen.

Kannst du mir vorab bitte folgende Fragen beantworten?

Wie identifiziert und qualifiziert euer KI-Agent Transformation-Leads, EA-Verantwortliche und IT-Entscheider?

Welche Regionen, Branchen und Unternehmensgrößen könnt ihr zuverlässig abdecken?

Unterstützt eure Plattform primär englische Kampagnen, oder sind weitere Sprachen möglich?

Welche Outreach-Kanäle automatisiert ihr (E-Mail, LinkedIn, Telefon/Voice), und wie funktioniert die Personalisierung dort jeweils?

Auf welche KPIs optimiert ihr typischerweise (z. B. Meetings, SQLs, Conversion-Rates)?

Wie integriert sich eure Lösung technisch in HubSpot (Kontaktsync, Aktivitäts-Logging, Meeting-Buchungen etc.)?

Habt ihr Erfahrung im B2B-SaaS-Umfeld oder speziell mit Anbietern im ServiceNow- bzw. EA-Ökosystem?

Wie ist euer Preismodell aufgebaut (monatlich, pro Lead, Hybrid)?

Wie sieht ein typisches Onboarding und die Einrichtung der ersten Kampagne für einen neuen Kunden aus?

Wenn diese Punkte gut zusammenpassen, können wir gerne einen kurzen Termin einplanen, um die Lösung im Detail zu besprechen.

Best regards,

Kadir Özbayram

CEO | Co-Founder

Hi Kadir,

Thanks for the detailed questions.
Since you are targeting high-value roles like Transformation Leads and Enterprise Architects, a generic approach wouldn't work. Here is how we handle your specific requirements at Mindaptive:
Identification & Qualification - We don't just use static lists; we research every single company and prospect individually using our AI systems to ensure they match your specific criteria. I cover exactly how this deep research works in the video demo linked below.
Regions & Industries - We cover every region globally and most industries. While our "sweet spot" is typically SMEs, we are also targeting enterprises for clients with offers similar to yours.
Language Capabilities - Our platform is fully multilingual. We can certainly execute your primary focus on English campaigns, but we are ready to scale into other languages if you expand later.
Outreach Channels - We automate both Cold Email and LinkedIn campaigns. The video below focuses on the email engine, but I can walk you through our specific LinkedIn workflows and personalization steps during our call.
KPIs & Optimization - We focus on Positive Responses. We typically optimize on a "Lead" basis—meaning we hand over prospects who have explicitly responded with interest to your offer.
HubSpot Integration - We can connect our tools directly to HubSpot. We can sync all contacts and set up automations so that when a meeting is booked or a prospect responds, a "Deal" is automatically created in your pipeline.
Experience - Our deepest experience is in the B2B SaaS sector, though we also work with agencies and consulting firms. We understand the nuances of selling complex technical solutions.
Pricing Model - We primarily work on a Pay-Per-Lead basis (ideal if you have an SDR team to take over the conversation). For teams that don't, we can discuss a Pay-Per-Meeting model, but we generally prefer optimizing for qualified leads.
Onboarding Process
Discovery Call: We define your ideal market and goals.
Proposal: We send you a custom strategy and exact pricing.
Kick-off: If accepted, we gather technical details, set up software licenses, and immediately start building the campaign.

Next Steps

messages.text:
Hey Trish,

I saw you’re on the main stage at the EDGE 2025 conference for supply chain pros. Pretty cool—bet it’s wild being part of that kind of panel.

Thanks,
Andrew Juran

lead.research_summary:
- LMI is a management consulting firm delivering commercial-grade tech and AI solutions for the U.S. federal government, spanning Defense, Homeland Security, Space, Intel, and Health & Civilian missions.
- Core service line relevant to this lead: Mission Operations & Logistics, including supply chain optimization, plus several proprietary AI/data platforms (RAPTR, IronSled, LIGER, SPECTR, SHEPRD).
- Contact: Trish Csank, VP of Supply Chain Intelligence, based at LMI's Tysons, VA HQ. Was on a main-stage panel at EDGE 2025 on "Resourceful Leadership."
- Original pitch: Mindaptive's AI-automated outbound/lead-gen agent to find and contact organizations needing supply chain logistics/modernization help (this is our REACH-stage B2B outbound product, not an inbound install).
- Deal history: Trish was highly interested and offered a call in Oct 2025, Andrew missed the window, follow-ups in Oct/Nov led to her saying "market headwinds have reshaped some priorities" and asking Mindaptive to pause, promising to reach out if things settled.
- Recent signal (as of this campaign's research, mid-2025 onward): LMI announced a partnership with Anduril for U.S. Army battlefield technology, a possible sign their federal contracting pipeline/budget environment is improving after the earlier headwinds.
- No review-signal relevance here (B2B federal consulting firm, not a review-driven local business).

lead.research_summary:
- Wirtualnemedia.pl is Poland's largest news portal covering media, advertising, PR, TV, radio, and marketing, part of Wirtualna Polska Group (acquired Jan 2024).
- Business model centers on ad revenue, sponsored/branded content, and industry events, meaning brand marketers and founders are their actual paying customers, a strong fit for Mindaptive's B2B outbound lead-gen agent (finding and booking meetings with brands wanting exposure).
- Michal (michal.barwinski@wirtualnemedia.pl) already responded positively to the outbound pitch and agreed in principle to a call.
- Michal raised a secondary angle: inviting/pitching Mindaptive around their "Brand New(s)" conference, Nov 20, Teatr 6p. w PKiN (Warsaw), worth probing on the call, could be a sponsorship/partnership opportunity or content angle worth understanding better.
- Michal was on an out-of-office/vacation autoresponder as of late Oct 2025; for urgent matters he listed a colleague, Przemysław Zbróg (przemyslaw.zbrog@wirtualnemedia.pl), and a phone number. Follow up after his return rather than pushing further during this gap.
- No review-signal or call-volume diagnostics apply here since this is a B2B media company, not a service business with public reviews.

draft.triage_summary:
- **Original pitch:** AI-automated outbound agent (B2B lead-gen / Reach-stage solution) that finds and contacts brand founders/marketers who want media exposure or paid features on portals like Wirtualnemedia.
- **Website diagnosis:** Wirtualnemedia.pl is Poland's largest media/marketing/advertising/PR news portal (part of Wirtualna Polska Group), covering TV, radio, press, digital, PR. This is a B2B media publisher whose revenue model depends on brands paying for features, sponsored content, and conference sponsorships, exactly the kind of client our outbound-agent product is built to find for them.
- **Diagnosed solution:** Stay with original pitch, AI outbound agent for sourcing brand/advertiser leads (catalog item #1, B2B Outbound track), not the inbound installer/clinic products.
- **Fit decision:** Stayed with original pitch, no pivot needed. It's a strong, direct fit for a media outlet monetizing brand partnerships.
- **VSL sent?** No. The VSL is HVAC/solar-specific and irrelevant to a media/PR company.
- **Objection handled:** None, technically. The lead's last message is an out-of-office autoresponder (he's on vacation, will reply on return). Before that, he'd already agreed to a call and raised a side pitch about their Brand New(s) conference (Nov 20). Response here is a short, low-pressure holding reply, acknowledging the OOO and briefly flagging we'll cover the conference angle on the call too. No hard push while he's away.
